scope: Published legacy inputs, equal old/new/authored test heights, pixel goal, T kept. Use the converter shape check for core, outline and colour under the declared renderer models; scene-dependent additive blending and recoil animation are not scored. Exact = identical appearance at the same position; shifted = identical after up to 1 px translation; approximate = remaining differences. IoU = intersection / union of same-colour pixels. Visible dot cores prioritize aiming overlap before outline coverage; lower total IoU is reported as a tradeoff. Empty targets have no score. Heights are controlled tests, not reported player resolutions. New records were not used to fit the solver or learners. These are not native accuracy measurements.
